memories.label: aster_seedling_schedule
memories.content: Aster greenhouse seedling watering takes place at dawn on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

memories.label: aster_seedling_dry_check
memories.content: Aster greenhouse seedling watering also requires a dusk check; add water only when the growing medium is dry.

memories.label: aster_herb_schedule
memories.content: Aster greenhouse herb watering takes place at noon every day.

memories.label: birch_seedling_schedule
memories.content: Birch greenhouse seedling watering takes place at dawn every day.

memories.label: birch_puncture_patch
memories.content: Birch bicycle puncture repair instructions: remove the tube, locate the hole, and apply a patch.

memories.label: birch_puncture_replace
memories.content: Birch bicycle puncture repair instructions: replace the tube when its tear is too large for a patch.

memories.label: birch_repair_poster
memories.content: The Birch bicycle puncture repair instructions are printed on a poster for the Saturday class.

memories.label: birch_chain_repair
memories.content: Birch bicycle chain repair uses a spare connecting link.

memories.label: cedar_reservation_method

memories.label: cedar_reservation_hold
memories.content: The Cedar workshop reservation procedure holds a booking for ten minutes after its booked start time.

memories.label: cedar_reservation_form
memories.content: The form for the Cedar workshop reservation procedure has blank fields labelled room capacity and contact details.

memories.label: vale_reservation_method
memories.content: The Vale workshop reservation procedure requires visitors to sign the book at the entrance counter.

memories.label: dune_dry_meeting_location

memories.label: dune_rain_meeting_location
memories.content: The Dune reading club meeting location moves to the north hall when rain is forecast.

memories.label: dune_minutes_cabinet
memories.content: The Dune reading club meeting minutes record the location of the west storage cabinet.

memories.label: vale_meeting_location
memories.content: The Vale reading club meeting location is the north hall every week.

memories.label: elm_catalog_approval

memories.label: elm_catalog_fields

memories.label: elm_catalog_training

memories.label: elm_artifact_storage

memories.label: fern_bread_base

memories.label: fern_bread_additions

memories.label: fern_cake_ingredients

queries.name: aster_seedling_watering
queries.rationale: Relevant memories supply the Aster seedling watering schedule and its dry-medium condition; either is a useful partial answer. aster_herb_schedule concerns different plants, and birch_seedling_schedule concerns a different greenhouse. Other labels supply no Aster seedling watering guidance.

queries.name: aster_herb_watering
queries.rationale: Only aster_herb_schedule supplies watering guidance for Aster herb pots. The Aster seedling memories concern different plants; the Birch schedule concerns another greenhouse. Partial word overlap does not make those instructions applicable.

queries.name: birch_puncture_instructions
queries.rationale: Both memories supply an actual puncture repair action, including the conditional replacement alternative. birch_repair_poster merely locates a document and names a class; it supplies no repair action. birch_chain_repair concerns a different bicycle component.

queries.name: birch_puncture_synonyms
queries.rationale: This asks for the same puncture repair guidance using punctured rather than puncture, British tyre spelling, and fix rather than repair. The same two action-bearing memories remain relevant regardless of lexical matching. The poster and chain repair remain irrelevant for the same reasons as the instructions query.

queries.name: cedar_reservation_procedure
queries.rationale: Both memories state an actual Cedar reservation procedure or rule: supplying the date to the desk and the ten-minute hold. cedar_reservation_form describes empty form fields, not a reservation action or hold rule. vale_reservation_method supplies another workshop policy.

queries.name: cedar_capacity_no_answer
queries.rationale: The requested room capacity is a number or explicit occupancy limit. cedar_reservation_form mentions a blank field labelled room capacity but supplies no value. No other memory states Cedar room capacity. A field name, contact detail or booking hold duration is not an occupancy answer.

queries.name: dune_meeting_location
queries.rationale: Both weather-conditional meeting venues answer this unqualified location query. dune_minutes_cabinet instead gives the location of a storage cabinet recorded in minutes, not the meeting venue. vale_meeting_location concerns another club. No priority is assigned between the two relevant weather conditions.

queries.name: dune_rain_location
queries.rationale: Only dune_rain_meeting_location supplies the venue under the requested rain condition. The dry-day courtyard rule does not supply the rainy-day venue; minutes storage and the Vale club do not answer this query.

queries.name: elm_catalog_requirements
queries.rationale: The two relevant memories supply actual update requirements: curator approval and required record fields. elm_catalog_training states a session time/place without any requirement, and elm_artifact_storage concerns physical storage rather than catalog updates.

queries.name: elm_catalog_synonyms
queries.rationale: Catalogue revision rules asks for the same artifact catalog update requirements using a spelling variant and synonyms. Curator approval and required fields remain relevant even if the current lexical path misses them. Training logistics and physical storage remain irrelevant.

queries.name: fern_bread_ingredients
queries.rationale: The two memories each provide part of the bread ingredient list. fern_oven_layout only says an ingredients chart exists and gives appliance layout; it names no ingredient. fern_cake_ingredients supplies a different recipe. Each actual bread-ingredient subset is relevant rather than requiring the entire list in one memory.

queries.name: fern_temperature_no_answer
queries.rationale: The requested oven temperature is a temperature value or setting for Fern bread. fern_oven_layout mentions a temperature dial but gives no temperature or setting. The ingredient records and cake recipe supply none either. A dial location does not answer a temperature question.
